name: ParleyMqtt
description: Request/response RPC over MQTT (MQTT RPC / request-reply) for ESP32/Arduino: call a typed command on another device or service and get one typed result back, with progress, cancellation and liveness heartbeats. Statically allocated, no exceptions or RTTI, tick-driven from loop(); needs only MQTT 3.1.1 and no MQTT-client dependency. Commander + handler protocol core over a consumer-supplied transport adapter and an ArduinoJson codec — one of four parallel implementations of the Parley v1 wire protocol (C++, C#, Python, TypeScript/JS).
keywords: mqtt, rpc, mqtt-rpc, request-response, request-reply, remote-procedure-call, esp32, arduino, embedded, iot, protocol, parley
